rationale: Price has recovered sharply from the session low of $22.89 back to $23.33, reclaiming both the 5-min VWAP ($23.19) and the 9-EMA ($23.21) — the two intraday benchmarks that originally confirmed seller control. The last four candles show a clear sequence of higher lows and higher highs with volume re-accelerating (119K and 93K+ on the last two momentum legs), indicating buyers have absorbed the gap-fade selling. The short thesis has deteriorated materially even though formal invalidation at $23.55 has not yet been triggered; continuing to hold adds drawdown risk for a position that has already given back all of its 1.12% MFE with no structural support nearby.
